meta.title: Delivery check
meta.description: Runs once before delivery: strips python-docx / python-pptx / openpyxl / LibreOffice fingerprints, recomputes real statistics, checks punctuation across Chinese, Japanese, Korean, English, French and German, and collects every item that would require fabrication into a side panel. Supports docx, pptx, xlsx, odt, ods, odp, and read-only pdf.
